title: TemporalSignedMBB: code and result files for ground-truth benchmarking of signed, directed lagged connectivity
description: Complete code package for the article “Ground-truth benchmarking of signed, directed lagged connectivity: TemporalSignedMBB from a simulated gut-brain model to neural data” (Cognitive Neurodynamics). It contains the tsmbb Python modules, the entry-point scripts of the original submission and of the revision, thirteen unit tests, an environment file and pinned requirements files, SHA-256 checksums of the two public neural datasets, the result files (JSON and NPZ) from which every number in the article is read, and the figure files.
